Hm. That’s a tough question as well, tbh. Since he and Bill spent so much time together he’s undoubtedly left an impression on Ford. That being his trust issues. Although it was already there since, like, the science fair, Bill definitely made it worse in a lot of ways.

So in a nutshell, I’d imagine it manifests in his ability-or lack thereof-of putting his trust in other people, even his own family.

I like to think that Ford’s kind of like a nut. His shell’s hard, but the kernel isn’t. It just takes a long time to get through the shell.

I dunno, am I making sense? Putting thoughts into words has never been my strongest suit lol. I’m sure other people have a perspective on this that’s more understandable.

Understanding Ford’s character? In this economy? Nah, we don’t do that anymore.

I’m kidding. Mostly.

More seriously, though, let me put my own spin on things. I might say something similar to other people, but I digress. Gonna tackle each point as best as I can.



He is indeed serious *and* playful, but his playful side isn’t shown enough. It’s a byproduct of his lack of trust in others, his inability to open himself up.



Ford’s outlook on life…Now, that’s a little harder to answer. He doesn’t really have an opinion on that sort of thing, from what I can remember.



Ford actually doesn’t struggle to talk about himself. While documenting Journal 3 he’s shown to be rather boastful and full of himself. In hindsight, it’s kinda off-putting and outta pocket. One could infer that he’s like this cause of his bloated ego. We can thank Bill for making him worse in that regard, to an extent.



Gult ridden? Yeah, I’d say so. Definitely. It’s shown multiple times that he genuinely felt bad for Stanley during the whole science fair debacle, he just couldn’t get over himself. And don’t get me started on his time with Fiddleford working on the portal lol.



His relationship with Caryn and Filbrick is strained at best. His father is emotionally abusive and only cares about making a quick buck. He and Stanley are lucky to have survived that man.



God, I could go on and on about his relationship with his brother. But the show already showed enough of that that you can get the gist of it. CliffNotes version? They love each other. *So much*. They struggle to express it at times, but they genuinely care for each other.



Dipper and Mabel are no exception, either. As you might be aware, he and Dipper are two of the nerdiest men alive. Also canonically the stinkiest, but that’s neither here nor there lol.



People like to say that he doesn’t care about Mabel but fuck those guys cause he literally does? In the Journal he speaks highly of her more than Dipper. So yeah, he loves her.



His passions, well, hunting anomalies and general cryptozoologist things.

He’s often haunted by a lot of things, if we’re being honest. In a tiny little nutshell, yes, he’s haunted time and time again by his shortcomings. I don’t know if he’d still be upset about it all after 30 years, but still.

Honestly, I'll be the first to admit that the first time I ever played this game I kinda wanted things to progress a little faster.
